text:
alex: Quick coordination note — we want to ship a unified bump to 0.12.0 for api, runtime, console, and the SDKs. Target cut: EOD Friday (UTC). Please reply with PR numbers and a one-line changelog bullet.

release-bot: Automated reminder: release window opens in 72h. Ensure CI green and changelogs added to PRs.

maria: ack. PRs I own: api#4521 (version bump + small doc tweak), sdk-js#778 (pull in new auth header behavior). Changelog: 'api: add optional request tracing header; sdk-js: support header passthrough'

sam: runtime#1029 is WIP — includes KV cache pointer change that may be semver-minor. Not sure if we should call that 0.12.0 or 0.12.0-rc? Asking infra/qa.

kai: re: runtime change — it's additive but touches on cache ABI for on-prem. From ops POV, mark as minor but add migration note. Lina, do you want a short test matrix for Private?

lina: yes, I'll run the 3-node on-prem upgrade flow tomorrow morning and paste results here. Quick ask: what's the final tag name convention? we usually do 'vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH'.

alex: tag convention stays v0.12.0. We'll do simultaneous tags across repos after merge. Release steps: 1) merge PRs into main, 2) run release-bot tag-and-changelog job, 3) cut canary for Dedicated, 4) promote.

maria: adding changelog snippets now. Also: api has a tiny client-facing change (opt-in header) — not breaking.

sam: runtime PR is at 95% CI, two flaky tests failing on p4. I'm going to pin quantization shim to avoid test flakiness; that'll keep it patch-level if accepted. If we keep shim, runtime can be patch bump instead.

kai: if runtime stays minor, we need an SDK bump for pinned loader behavior. sdk-go#214 will follow if runtime goes minor.

alex: please declare final decisions by Thursday 16:00 UTC so release-bot has time to assemble changelogs automatically. If anyone needs more runway, call it out now.

maria: noted. api#4521 merged and changelog added.

sam: runtime#1029 — I'll push shim in ~30m, then re-run CI. If green, I'll retarget to patch and post here.

lina: on-prem smoke passed for the shim path. no upgrade rollback observed.

release-bot: tag job queued: to run once all PRs merged. Use `/release status` for live progress.

alex: checklist snippet (put in root comment of each PR):
```
- [ ] version bumped to 0.12.0 (or 0.11.x for patch)
- [ ] changelog entry (1-line)
- [ ] compatibility note for Private (if applicable)
- [ ] nominate for simultaneous tag
```

kai: pinging sdk-go owner (cc @matt) — if runtime stays minor, please prep sdk-go#214.

maria: everything except SDKs green.

sam: CI green after shim, retargeted to patch. runtime will stay 0.11.5 -> 0.11.6. That means we do NOT need SDK bump for loader.

alex: OK—final plan: api: 0.12.0, console: 0.12.0 (console change is telemetry flag), sdk-js: 0.12.0, runtime: 0.11.6 (patch). We'll still do the simultaneous tag naming but note runtime is not a minor.

lina: I'll annotate the release playbook with the deviation (runtime patch) and run smoke tests after tagging.

alex: thanks all. Final request: paste your PR numbers and a one-line changelog here once merged. I'll trigger release-bot to run at Friday 17:00 UTC.
